image_prompts: A colorful ribbon tied into a decorative bow on a gift box
A wooden bow with an arrow nocked, ready to be released towards a target
words.image_desc_en: A decorative ribbon bow and an archery bow with an arrow.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个装饰性的丝带蝴蝶结和一把带有箭的弓。
words.meaning_cn: n. 弓；蝴蝶结；v. 鞠躬
words.usage: n. / v. (过去式 bowed, 过去分词 bowed)
words.collocations: take a bow, bow to

examples.en: She tied a pretty bow on the gift for her friend.
examples.cn: 她为给朋友的礼物系了一个漂亮的蝴蝶结。

examples.en: The actor took a bow after the successful play.
examples.cn: 演员在成功的演出后鞠躬谢幕。

socratic_questions.question: 在舞台表演结束后，演员通常会做什么动作来感谢观众？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个动作表示尊敬和感谢，身体前倾。

sentences: The musician took a ___ after his amazing performance.

image_prompts: Two chocolate candies shaped like lips, about to touch
A red lipstick mark on a white napkin, close-up shot
words.image_desc_en: Visuals representing a kiss, such as lip-shaped candies or a lipstick mark.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表亲吻的视觉元素，例如嘴唇形状的糖果或口红印。
words.collocations: give a kiss, blow a kiss

examples.en: She gave her grandma a kiss before leaving home.
examples.cn: 她离开家前亲吻了她的奶奶。

examples.en: They shared a quick kiss in the school hallway.
examples.cn: 他们在学校走廊分享了一个短暂的吻。

socratic_questions.question: 当表达喜爱或告别时，有时我们会用什么动作来表达爱意？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个动作通常涉及嘴唇的接触，表达情感。

sentences: He leaned in to ___ her on the forehead.

image_prompts: A hand waving hello in front of a bright blue sky
A welcome mat at a front door with a friendly message
words.image_desc_en: A waving hand and a welcome mat.
words.image_desc_cn: 挥舞的手和欢迎垫。
words.usage: v. (过去式 greeted, 过去分词 greeted)
words.collocations: greet warmly, greet politely

examples.en: I always greet my classmates with a smile every morning.
examples.cn: 我每天早上总是面带微笑地问候我的同学们。

examples.en: They greet visitors at the entrance of the school building.
examples.cn: 他们在教学楼入口处迎接来访者。

socratic_questions.question: 当你见到朋友或家人时，你会做什么来表达你的友好？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个动作通常包括说“你好”或微笑。

sentences: We should always ___ our elders with respect and kindness.

image_prompts: A hammock gently swaying between two palm trees on a tropical beach, clear blue sky
A steaming cup of herbal tea beside a book on a cozy armchair, soft lighting
words.image_desc_en: A hammock on a beach and a cup of tea by a book.
words.image_desc_cn: 海滩上的吊床和书旁的茶杯。
words.collocations: feel relaxed, relaxed atmosphere, relaxed attitude

examples.en: After the exam, I felt so relaxed and happy.
examples.cn: 考试之后，我感到非常放松和快乐。

examples.en: The teacher created a relaxed atmosphere in the classroom.
examples.cn: 老师在教室里营造了一种轻松的氛围。

socratic_questions.question: 当你完成一项困难的任务后，你感觉如何？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 描述一种没有压力、舒适的状态。

sentences: She felt very ___ after her yoga session.

image_prompts: A gold coin with a number representing its worth, shimmering light
A family heirloom watch passed down through generations, antique wooden box
words.image_desc_en: A representation of monetary worth and sentimental importance.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表金钱价值和情感重要性的事物。
words.meaning_cn: n. 价值；重要性 v. 重视；评估
words.usage: n. (复数 values) ; v. (过去式 valued, 过去分词 valued)
words.collocations: add value to, high value, moral values

examples.en: We should value our friendships and family relationships highly.
examples.cn: 我们应该高度重视我们的友谊和家庭关系。

examples.en: The antique car has a high value because of its rarity.
examples.cn: 这辆古董车因其稀有性而具有很高的价值。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你发现一件东西既实用又美观，你会怎么描述它？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示某物的优点或重要性。

sentences: I really ___ the time we spend together as a family.

image_prompts: A bedroom decorated with posters of musical bands and colorful lights.
A collection of books, headphones, and a skateboard scattered on a desk.
words.image_desc_en: A room and items representing typical teenage interests.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表典型青少年兴趣的房间和物品。
words.collocations: teenage years, teenage life, teenage dreams

examples.en: She is going through a difficult teenage phase right now.
examples.cn: 她现在正经历一个困难的青少年阶段。

examples.en: Many teenage students enjoy playing sports after school every day.
examples.cn: 许多青少年学生每天放学后都喜欢运动。

socratic_questions.question: 描述一个年龄段，这个年龄段的人通常在上中学，有自己的兴趣爱好和烦恼。
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个年龄段通常是13岁到19岁之间。

sentences: The library has a special section for ___ fiction books.

image_prompts: A framed photograph showing a smiling elderly woman with a young girl
A family tree illustration highlighting the connection between a grandparent and a female descendant
words.image_desc_en: A photo and a family tree showing a granddaughter.
words.image_desc_cn: 一张照片和一棵家谱树，展示了孙女。
words.collocations: loving granddaughter, proud granddaughter

examples.en: My granddaughter visits me every Sunday, which makes me happy.
examples.cn: 我的孙女每个星期天都来看我，这让我很高兴。

examples.en: She is her grandfather's only granddaughter, so he loves her dearly.
examples.cn: 她是她祖父唯一的孙女，所以他非常爱她。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你的父母有一个女儿，而你是她的孩子，并且你是女性，那么你和你的祖父母是什么关系？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 考虑家庭关系中，祖父母和女性后代之间的称谓。

sentences: Their only ___ inherited their artistic talent and became a painter.

image_prompts: A well-trained dog sitting patiently with a treat on its nose, waiting for permission
A set of etiquette books neatly stacked on a polished table, soft lighting
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations depicting good manners and proper conduct.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘良好礼仪和得体行为的插图。
words.collocations: behave well/badly, behave oneself

examples.en: You should behave politely when you meet your teachers at school.
examples.cn: 你在学校遇到老师时应该表现得有礼貌。

examples.en: Did the children behave well during the long car journey yesterday?
examples.cn: 昨天孩子们在漫长的汽车旅途中表现得好吗？

socratic_questions.question: 如果你在公共场合，应该注意什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 要考虑你的举止是否符合规范。

sentences: Please ___ yourself properly during the important meeting, it matters a lot.

image_prompts: A group of colorful balloons floating upwards, one balloon is deflated and falling down
A row of identical books on a shelf, one book is upside down
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations showing 'except' as something excluded or different.
words.image_desc_cn: 用图例展示“except”表示排除或不同的含义。
words.usage: prep. 除了…之外；conj. 只是；除非
words.collocations: except for, except that

examples.en: Everyone enjoyed the party except for the loud music.
examples.cn: 除了吵闹的音乐，每个人都喜欢这个聚会。

examples.en: I like all fruits except bananas; they taste strange.
examples.cn: 我喜欢所有的水果，除了香蕉；它们味道很奇怪。

socratic_questions.question: 如果在一堆相似的物品中，有一个是不同的，你会用什么词来表达这种不同？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示从整体中排除某一部分。

sentences: I like all kinds of sports ___ swimming in cold water.

image_prompts: A diagram showing two overlapping circles, the overlapping area highlighted
A road sign showing two roads merging into one
words.image_desc_en: Overlapping circles representing connection; roads merging into one.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表连接的重叠圆圈；汇合成一条道路的两条路。
words.collocations: coordinating conjunction, subordinating conjunction

examples.en: The word 'and' is a common conjunction in English grammar.
examples.cn: 单词“and”在英语语法中是一个常见的连词。

examples.en: We learned about different types of conjunctions in our English class.
examples.cn: 我们在英语课上学习了不同类型的连词。

socratic_questions.question: 在英语句子中，什么词可以将两个词、短语或句子连接起来？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词的作用是连接不同的部分，使句子更完整。

sentences: The word 'but' is a ___ that connects two contrasting ideas.

image_prompts: A close-up of a bent human elbow joint, showing the skin and slight muscle definition
A diagram illustrating the bones and ligaments of the elbow joint, labeled clearly
words.image_desc_en: Images depicting the human elbow joint.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘人体肘关节的图像。
words.collocations: at the elbow, elbow room, elbow grease
words.preposition_combos: on the elbow, with the elbow

examples.en: She leaned on the table, resting her chin on her elbow.
examples.cn: 她靠在桌子上，下巴支在肘部。

examples.en: The tight space gave me no elbow room to work properly.
examples.cn: 狭窄的空间让我没有足够的活动空间来好好工作。

socratic_questions.question: 当你胳膊弯曲时，中间的那个关节是什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 它是手臂中间可以弯曲的部分。

sentences: He accidentally bumped his ___ on the corner of the desk.

image_prompts: A time-lapse of a melting ice cube, showing the water level rising slowly
A plant growing from a seed, with each stage of growth slightly taller than the last
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations showing a slow and progressive change over time.
words.image_desc_cn: 展示随时间推移缓慢而逐渐变化的插图。
words.collocations: gradually increase, gradually decrease, gradually change

examples.en: The weather gradually became warmer as spring arrived this year.
examples.cn: 今年春天来临时，天气逐渐变暖。

examples.en: My English improved gradually after many months of hard study.
examples.cn: 经过几个月的努力学习，我的英语逐渐提高。

socratic_questions.question: 如果事情不是一下子发生，而是慢慢地、一点一点地变化，你会用哪个词来描述？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示变化是缓慢的，不是突然的。

sentences: The pain in my leg ___ disappeared after I rested for a while.

image_prompts: A wise owl perched on a branch, holding a scroll
A compass pointing towards the right direction on a map
words.image_desc_en: An owl with a scroll and a compass showing direction.
words.image_desc_cn: 一只拿着卷轴的猫头鹰和一个显示方向的指南针。
words.usage: v. (过去式 advised, 过去分词 advised); advice (n.)
words.collocations: advise sb. to do sth., advise against doing sth.

examples.en: I advise you to study hard for the upcoming exam.
examples.cn: 我建议你为即将到来的考试努力学习。

examples.en: My parents advise me on choosing a suitable career path.
examples.cn: 我的父母在选择合适的职业道路上给我建议。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你朋友遇到难题，你会怎么做来帮助他？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 提供一些有用的意见或建议。

sentences: The teacher ___ the students to read more English books.

image_prompts: A chameleon gradually changing its skin color to match a new leaf
A seedling slowly growing and adapting to a new environment in a garden
words.image_desc_en: Adapting to a new environment or situation.
words.image_desc_cn: 适应新的环境或情况。
words.usage: v. 习惯于，适应 (getting used to, got used to)
words.collocations: get used to doing sth, get used to the climate, get used to the food

examples.en: I will get used to the busy school life soon.
examples.cn: 我很快就会习惯忙碌的学校生活。

examples.en: She got used to speaking English every day in class.
examples.cn: 她已经习惯了每天在课堂上说英语。

socratic_questions.question: 当你刚到一个新地方，一开始不适应，但过一段时间后感觉好多了，这是什么过程？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个过程表示逐渐适应并感觉舒适。

sentences: It takes time to ___ the new school rules.

image_prompts: A lightbulb appearing above a stack of books, representing a new idea
A suggestion box with various notes sticking out, placed in a bright office
words.image_desc_en: A lightbulb above books; a suggestion box.
words.image_desc_cn: 书本上方的灯泡；建议箱。
words.collocations: make a suggestion, accept a suggestion, follow a suggestion

examples.en: I have a suggestion that might help solve this difficult problem.
examples.cn: 我有一个建议，可能有助于解决这个难题。

examples.en: Her suggestion to recycle more paper was accepted by the committee.
examples.cn: 她关于多回收纸张的建议被委员会采纳了。

socratic_questions.question: 当你想帮助朋友解决问题，你会给他们什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 是提供给别人，希望他们采纳的意见或想法。

sentences: The teacher welcomed any ___ for improving the class activities.

image_prompts: A small package falling gently onto a doormat in front of a house
A quick visit to a bakery, illustrated by a bicycle parked briefly outside a shop with a 'Open' sign
words.image_desc_en: A package dropping onto a doormat; a bicycle parked outside a bakery.
words.image_desc_cn: 包裹落在门垫上；自行车停在面包店外。
words.collocations: drop by for a visit, drop by someone's house
words.preposition_combos: drop by at, drop by on

examples.en: Please drop by my house if you have some free time.
examples.cn: 如果你有空，请顺便来我家拜访。

examples.en: I might drop by the library after school to borrow books.
examples.cn: 放学后我可能会顺便去图书馆借书。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你路过朋友家附近，想短时间拜访一下，你会怎么说？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 表示非正式的、短暂的拜访。

sentences: They decided to ___ the new cafe after their shopping trip.

image_prompts: A city skyline with prominent government buildings, national flags waving
A close-up of a document with the words 'Capital Investment' highlighted
words.image_desc_en: A city with government buildings and a document about investment.
words.image_desc_cn: 一座有政府建筑的城市和一份关于投资的文件。
words.collocations: capital city, capital investment, raise capital

examples.en: Beijing is the capital of China, a very historical city.
examples.cn: 北京是中国的首都，一座非常具有历史意义的城市。

examples.en: He needs capital to start his own small business now.
examples.cn: 他现在需要资金来开始他自己的小生意。

socratic_questions.question: 哪个城市通常是国家的政治中心，并且政府所在地？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个城市是国家的行政中心。

sentences: London is the ___ of England, a major global city.

image_prompts: A winding road leading to a distant mountain range, suggesting a long journey that was completed
A trophy displayed on a shelf, signifying victory achieved despite initial doubts
words.image_desc_en: A scenic route and a trophy, representing completion and achievement.
words.image_desc_cn: 一条风景优美的道路和一个奖杯，代表完成和成就。
words.usage: 短语。表示经过考虑或努力后得出的结论或结果。
words.collocations: not after all, after all is said and done

examples.en: I did pass the exam after all, even though I was nervous.
examples.cn: 我毕竟还是通过了考试，尽管我很紧张。

examples.en: We decided to stay home after all because of the heavy rain.
examples.cn: 因为下大雨，我们最终决定待在家里。

socratic_questions.question: 你原本不确定能否成功，但最终结果却出乎意料地好，你会用哪个短语来表达这种转折？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个短语表示最终的结果与之前的预期不同，带有‘最终’、‘终究’的含义。

sentences: She managed to finish the race, ___ her initial difficulties.

image_prompts: A sundial casting a short shadow at the peak of the day
A clock showing 12:00 with bright sunlight streaming through a window
words.image_desc_en: A sundial showing the shortest shadow of the day; A clock at 12:00 with bright sunlight.
words.image_desc_cn: 日晷显示一天中最短的阴影；时钟指向12:00，阳光明媚。
words.collocations: at noon, around noon, before noon

examples.en: We usually have lunch at noon in the school canteen.
examples.cn: 我们通常在学校食堂中午吃午饭。

examples.en: The sun is usually at its highest point at noon.
examples.cn: 太阳通常在中午达到最高点。

socratic_questions.question: 一天中太阳最高、影子最短的时间是什么时候？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 指一天中白天的中间时间。

sentences: The meeting is scheduled to start at ___ tomorrow.
The sun is at its highest point at ___.

image_prompts: A pressure cooker with steam violently escaping from the valve
A shattered mirror with cracks radiating outwards, reflecting distorted images
words.image_desc_en: An image representing extreme anger or frustration.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表极度愤怒或沮丧的图像。
words.usage: adj. (比较级 madder, 最高级 maddest); adv. madly (非正式)
words.collocations: go mad, get mad, drive someone mad

examples.en: She was mad at her brother for breaking her new toy.
examples.cn: 她因为弟弟弄坏了她的新玩具而生气。

examples.en: The loud noise made me so mad that I couldn't concentrate.
examples.cn: 巨大的噪音让我非常生气，以至于我无法集中注意力。

socratic_questions.question: 当你发现有人未经允许就拿走了你的东西，你会感到什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这种感觉通常是强烈的不满和愤怒。

sentences: He got really ___ when he found out about the broken window.

image_prompts: A pressure gauge with the needle pointing to the red zone, steam escaping
A volcano erupting with lava and smoke, fiery sky in the background
words.image_desc_en: A gauge indicating extreme pressure; An erupting volcano.
words.image_desc_cn: 指示极端压力的仪表；一座爆发的火山。
words.collocations: get mad at, get mad about
words.preposition_combos: get mad at/with (someone), get mad about (something)

examples.en: I get mad when people are late for important meetings.
examples.cn: 当人们在重要会议上迟到时，我会生气。

examples.en: Don't get mad at me; it wasn't my fault this time.
examples.cn: 别对我生气；这次不是我的错。

socratic_questions.question: 当你发现你的朋友未经允许就拿走了你的东西，你会有什么感觉？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这种感觉通常是负面的，表示一种强烈的不满。

sentences: He will ___ if you break his new video game console.

image_prompts: A person climbing a steep hill, sweat droplets visible, determined expression
A stack of books with a magnifying glass focusing on the top book, highlighting key details
words.image_desc_en: Climbing a hill requires effort; Studying hard requires effort.
words.image_desc_cn: 爬山需要努力；努力学习需要付出努力。
words.collocations: make an effort, put in effort, with effort

examples.en: She made an effort to learn English well this semester.
examples.cn: 她这学期努力学习英语。

examples.en: It takes a lot of effort to finish the project on time.
examples.cn: 按时完成这个项目需要付出很多努力。

socratic_questions.question: 为了完成一项困难的任务，你需要投入什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 完成任务需要投入时间和精力。

sentences: He put a lot of ___ into finishing the difficult task.

image_prompts: A person struggling to climb a steep hill, representing effort and determination
A close-up of hands planting a small tree, symbolizing the effort to improve the environment
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations depicting the concept of exerting oneself to achieve a goal.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘努力实现目标的插图。
words.collocations: make a great effort, make every effort, make little effort
words.preposition_combos: make an effort to do something

examples.en: We should all make an effort to protect our environment now.
examples.cn: 我们现在都应该努力保护我们的环境。

examples.en: He needs to make an effort to improve his study habits.
examples.cn: 他需要努力去改善他的学习习惯。

socratic_questions.question: 当你想要提高你的英语成绩，你会怎么做？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 需要付出行动，积极尝试。

sentences: You need to ___ to finish the project on time.

image_prompts: A dark blue passport with official stamps from various countries, lying on a world map
A passport photo page with a serious expression, next to an immigration stamp
words.image_desc_en: A passport with stamps and a passport photo.
words.image_desc_cn: 带有签证印章和护照照片的护照。
words.collocations: apply for a passport, valid passport, passport control
words.preposition_combos: with a passport, without a passport

examples.en: I need to renew my passport before my trip next month.
examples.cn: 我需要在下个月旅行之前更新我的护照。

examples.en: She showed her passport at the airport security check easily.
examples.cn: 她在机场安检时轻松地出示了她的护照。

socratic_questions.question: 出国旅行时，你需要携带什么证件来证明你的身份和国籍？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这是国际旅行中必不可少的身份证明文件。

sentences: You must have a valid ___ to travel to other countries.

image_prompts: A sparkling clean window with sunlight streaming through it
A robot vacuum cleaner moving across a polished wooden floor
words.image_desc_en: Images depicting cleanliness and the act of cleaning.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘清洁和清洁行为的图像。
words.collocations: clean room, clean energy, clean up

examples.en: We must keep our classroom clean every day after school.
examples.cn: 我们每天放学后必须保持教室干净。

examples.en: She needs to clean her room before her friends come over.
examples.cn: 在朋友来访之前，她需要打扫她的房间。

socratic_questions.question: 描述一个房间，里面没有灰尘、污渍，物品摆放整齐。
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个房间的状态是...？

sentences: It is important to ___ our environment to protect wildlife.

image_prompts: A piece of white chalk lying on a dark green chalkboard
A box of colorful chalk sticks arranged neatly on a wooden table
words.image_desc_en: A piece/box of chalk
words.image_desc_cn: 一块/一盒粉笔
words.collocations: piece of chalk, write with chalk

examples.en: The teacher used chalk to write the formula on the board.
examples.cn: 老师用粉笔在黑板上写下了公式。

examples.en: She picked up a piece of chalk and started drawing a cat.
examples.cn: 她拿起一支粉笔，开始画一只猫。

socratic_questions.question: 在教室里，老师通常用什么在黑板上写字？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 一种白色的、可以用来书写的工具，写在黑板上。

sentences: The artist used colored ___ to create a beautiful street painting.

image_prompts: A green chalkboard covered in mathematical equations and diagrams, chalk dust visible
A vintage wooden framed blackboard with the words 'Hello Class' written in white chalk
words.image_desc_en: A chalkboard with equations or a vintage blackboard with a greeting.
words.image_desc_cn: 一块写满方程式的黑板，或一块写着问候语的复古黑板。
words.collocations: clean the blackboard, write on the blackboard

examples.en: The teacher wrote the new words on the blackboard clearly.
examples.cn: 老师清楚地在黑板上写下了新单词。

examples.en: Could you please clean the blackboard after the class ends?
examples.cn: 下课后你能帮忙擦一下黑板吗？

socratic_questions.question: 在教室里，老师通常用什么来写字和画图，以便全班同学都能看到？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 它通常是黑色或绿色的，可以用粉笔在上面书写。

sentences: The teacher asked a student to write the answer on the ___.

image_prompts: A compass pointing towards the north direction in a snowy landscape
A map highlighting the upper part of a country, indicating the north region
words.image_desc_en: A compass indicating north; a map highlighting the northern region.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个指向北方的指南针；一张突出显示北部区域的地图。
words.collocations: northern lights, northern Europe, northern part

examples.en: The northern part of China has a cold climate in winter.
examples.cn: 中国北方冬季气候寒冷。

examples.en: We plan to visit the northern cities during our summer vacation.
examples.cn: 我们计划在暑假期间参观北部城市。

socratic_questions.question: 如果一个国家或地区的上方，通常比较冷的地方，我们称它为什么方向的？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 描述的是一个地理方位，与寒冷地区相关。

sentences: The ___ lights are a beautiful natural phenomenon seen in cold areas.

image_prompts: A vintage book with aged, yellowed pages, soft focus
A weathered wooden sign with faded paint, rustic texture
words.image_desc_en: Aged or old, showing signs of wear or time.
words.image_desc_cn: 老旧的，陈旧的，显示出磨损或时间痕迹的。
words.usage: 形容词，表示某物或某人已经存在很长时间，或显示出岁月的痕迹。
words.collocations: aged cheese, aged wine, aged building

examples.en: This aged building has a rich history that is very interesting.
examples.cn: 这座古老的建筑有着非常有趣且丰富的历史。

examples.en: The aged book had yellow pages and a worn cover.
examples.cn: 这本旧书有着发黄的页面和磨损的封面。

socratic_questions.question: 当你看到一个东西，它有很多岁月的痕迹，你会怎么形容它？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词形容某物存在很久，有老旧的特征。

sentences: The ___ tree in the park provides a lot of shade.

image_prompts: A sandy beach meeting the ocean, gentle waves washing ashore
A winding road hugging a cliff overlooking the sea, clear blue sky
words.image_desc_en: A beach and a coastal road.
words.image_desc_cn: 海滩和沿海公路。
words.collocations: along the coast, east coast, west coast, coastal city
words.preposition_combos: on the coast, along the coast

examples.en: We plan to visit the beautiful coast during summer vacation.
examples.cn: 我们计划在暑假期间参观美丽的海岸。

examples.en: The ship will coast along the shore for several hours.
examples.cn: 这艘船将沿着海岸航行几个小时。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你想在沙滩上玩耍，或者看海，你会去哪里？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 通常指陆地与海洋交界的地方。

sentences: They drove along the ___ to enjoy the stunning views.

image_prompts: A tree with leaves changing color from green to red and yellow, representing autumn
A calendar divided into four sections, each representing a different time of year with corresponding weather symbols
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations representing autumn foliage and a calendar divided into four seasons.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表秋季树叶和分为四季的日历的插图。
words.collocations: in season, dry season, rainy season

examples.en: Spring is my favorite season because the weather is nice.
examples.cn: 春天是我最喜欢的季节，因为天气很好。

examples.en: Many tourists visit this island during the summer season.
examples.cn: 许多游客在夏季来到这个岛屿游玩。

socratic_questions.question: 一年中，气候和景色会发生周期性变化的时间段，我们称为什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 一年被划分成几个不同的时间段，每个时间段都有独特的气候特征。

sentences: The rainy ___ in this area usually lasts for three months.

image_prompts: A wooden door with a brass knocker, the knocker raised to strike the door
A fist gently rapping on a closed door, creating a soft sound
words.image_desc_en: A door being knocked on.
words.image_desc_cn: 敲门。
words.collocations: knock at the door, knock on wood, knock into
words.preposition_combos: knock at, knock on, knock into

examples.en: Please knock on the door before you enter my room.
examples.cn: 请你在进入我的房间前敲门。

examples.en: I heard a knock at the door late last night.
examples.cn: 我昨晚深夜听到敲门声。

socratic_questions.question: 当你站在紧闭的房门前，想要引起里面人的注意，你会怎么做？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 需要发出声音，但不是用喊叫的方式。

sentences: Did you ___ on the door before you came in?

image_prompts: A compass pointing towards the eastern direction, sunrise in the background
A map highlighting the eastern part of a country, geographical features
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations representing the eastern direction and geographical location.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表东方的方向和地理位置的插图。
words.collocations: eastern Europe, eastern coast, eastern culture

examples.en: Shanghai is a large city located in the eastern part of China.
examples.cn: 上海是中国东部的一个大城市。

examples.en: The eastern coast of the United States is known for its beaches.
examples.cn: 美国东海岸以其海滩而闻名。

socratic_questions.question: 如果一个城市位于太阳升起的方向，我们通常称它位于哪个方位？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个方位与日出有关，是地图上的一个基本方向。

sentences: The sun rises in the ___ sky every morning, painting it with colors.

image_prompts: An airplane ascending into the sky, leaving a trail of white smoke
A rocket launching from a pad, flames erupting from the base
words.image_desc_en: Images depicting the action of something leaving the ground and ascending.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘某物离开地面并上升的动作的图像。
words.usage: v. (过去式 took off, 过去分词 taken off)
words.collocations: take off a hat, take off shoes, take off early

examples.en: The plane will take off on time if the weather is good.
examples.cn: 如果天气好的话，飞机将会准时起飞。

examples.en: I had to take off my coat because it was too warm.
examples.cn: 我不得不脱掉外套，因为太热了。

socratic_questions.question: 当你乘坐飞机时，飞机在跑道上加速后会做什么？或者，进入室内，你觉得热时会做什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 飞机离开地面；脱掉身上的衣物。

sentences: Please ___ your shoes before entering the house; it's a custom.

image_prompts: A gold coin on a velvet cushion, sparkling light
A vintage map leading to a treasure chest, old parchment
words.image_desc_en: A gold coin and a treasure map, representing value.
words.image_desc_cn: 一枚金币和一张藏宝图，代表价值。
words.meaning_cn: adj. 值得的；有...价值的；n. 价值
words.collocations: be worth doing, be worth something, prove worth

examples.en: This old book is worth a lot of money now.
examples.cn: 这本旧书现在很值钱。

examples.en: The trip to the museum was worth the long wait.
examples.cn: 去博物馆的旅行值得长时间的等待。

socratic_questions.question: 如果某样东西很有用或者很有意义，我们会用哪个词来形容它的价值？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示某物具有积极的意义或优点，可以抵消所花费的努力或金钱。

sentences: Is this broken computer ___ repairing, or should I buy a new one?

image_prompts: A etiquette guide book on a polished wooden table, soft lighting
A formal dining table setting with fine china and silverware
words.image_desc_en: A guide book and a formal dining table setting.
words.image_desc_cn: 一本礼仪指南和正式的餐桌布置。
words.collocations: in a manner, good manners, bad manners

examples.en: He always behaves in a polite manner towards his teachers.
examples.cn: 他总是以礼貌的态度对待他的老师。

examples.en: It is important to teach children good manners at home.
examples.cn: 在家教孩子们良好的礼仪非常重要。

socratic_questions.question: 当你在公共场合表现得很有教养时，你展示的是什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词指的是行为举止和礼仪。

sentences: She accepted the award in a humble ___ , thanking everyone involved.

image_prompts: A completely clear glass bottle on a white table, studio lighting
An auditorium with no audience members, all seats unoccupied
words.image_desc_en: An empty bottle and an empty auditorium.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个空瓶子和一个空礼堂。
words.usage: adj. / v. (过去式 emptied, 过去分词 emptied)
words.collocations: empty space, empty words, empty promises

examples.en: The classroom was empty after school, with no students left.
examples.cn: 放学后教室空无一人，没有学生留下。

examples.en: I felt empty after the long exam, needing a good rest.
examples.cn: 考完漫长的考试后，我感到空虚，需要好好休息。

socratic_questions.question: 描述一个容器，里面没有任何东西。
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词形容里面什么都没有的状态。

sentences: Please ___ the trash can before you leave the classroom today.

image_prompts: A simple wooden chair with a plain design, natural lighting
A textbook open to a page explaining fundamental mathematical principles, clear diagrams
words.image_desc_en: A simple chair and a textbook showing fundamental principles.
words.image_desc_cn: 一把简单的椅子和一本展示基本原理的教科书。
words.collocations: basic knowledge, basic skills, basic needs

examples.en: We need to learn some basic English grammar rules first.
examples.cn: 我们需要先学习一些基本的英语语法规则。

examples.en: This course covers the basic principles of computer science.
examples.cn: 这门课程涵盖了计算机科学的基本原理。

socratic_questions.question: 如果想盖一栋房子，首先需要做什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 需要打好地基，学习一些入门的知识。

sentences: This is a ___ introduction to the topic; we'll go deeper later.

image_prompts: Two hands exchanging a gift wrapped in colorful paper, focus on the hands
A currency exchange booth with various flags representing different countries
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations depicting the act of exchanging a gift and a currency exchange booth.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘了交换礼物和货币兑换亭的插图。
words.collocations: exchange ideas, exchange gifts, cultural exchange

examples.en: We can exchange ideas about how to improve our school.
examples.cn: 我们可以交流关于如何改进我们学校的想法。

examples.en: The students will exchange gifts during the Christmas party.
examples.cn: 学生们将在圣诞派对上交换礼物。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你把你的旧玩具给你的朋友，然后他给你他的旧书，这是什么行为？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这是互相给予和接受的行为。

sentences: The two countries decided to ___ ambassadors to improve relations.

image_prompts: A winding road leading to a distant mountain peak, symbolizing effort
A hand pointing towards a detour sign on a highway, indicating a change of route
words.image_desc_en: A winding road and a detour sign, symbolizing extra effort and a change of usual path.
words.image_desc_cn: 蜿蜒的道路和绕行标志，象征着额外的努力和改变通常的路径。
words.collocations: go out of my way, go out of her way, go out of their way
words.preposition_combos: go out of one's way to do something

examples.en: He went out of his way to help me with my homework.
examples.cn: 他特意帮助我做作业。

examples.en: She always goes out of her way to make new students feel welcome.
examples.cn: 她总是特意让新同学感到受欢迎。

socratic_questions.question: 当你非常努力地帮助别人，甚至超出你通常会做的，你会怎么描述这种行为？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个短语表示你做了超出常规的事情来帮助别人。

sentences: They ___ to make sure everyone had a great time at the party.

image_prompts: A pottery wheel with clay being shaped into a vase, tools nearby
Ingredients on a kitchen counter, a recipe book open, suggesting cooking
words.image_desc_en: Pottery shaping and cooking ingredients.
words.image_desc_cn: 陶器制作和烹饪食材。
words.collocations: make a mistake, make friends, make progress, make sure

examples.en: Did you make any friends during your summer camp last year?
examples.cn: 去年夏令营期间你交到朋友了吗？

examples.en: Please make sure to turn off the lights before you leave.
examples.cn: 请确保离开前关掉灯。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你要完成一件物品或者创造一些东西，你会用哪个动词？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示创造或完成某事。

sentences: I need to ___ a decision about which college to attend.
